## Detection objective

What suspicious behavior should this rule identify?

## Evidence

What observable event fields support the detection?

## Detection logic

Describe thresholds, time windows, correlation, exclusions, and edge cases.

## Risk factors

How should the detection affect risk scoring?

## False positives

What legitimate activity can resemble this behavior?

## Test fixtures

List synthetic/sanitized examples needed for tests.

## MITRE ATT&CK

Technique/sub-technique only when evidence supports the mapping.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deterministic behavior
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] False-positive cases covered
- [ ] Risk factors documented
